question: Measure fresh-process readiness for local DeepSeek DSX T16, first process-start and immediate warm-page-cache restart, with both RTX 3090s assigned.
profile: DSX/Xolotl Linux; context 131072; arena 70 GiB; no vision; loopback.
gpu_topology: GPU0+GPU1; DSX_GPUS=0,1, no single-GPU fallback; each RTX 3090 must gain at least 1 GiB at readiness.
cold_definition: Fresh process, no DSX model resident in VRAM. Do not flush global page cache; page-cache state is uncontrolled and likely warm from prior tests.
hot_definition: Clean stop then immediate fresh-process restart with identical model/flags; file pages are recently accessed and remain hot only to the extent the OS retains them.
measurement: Monotonic Popen-to-healthy GET /health; readiness only, no inference request and no TTFT claim.
stop_conditions: another inference server or compute client appears
MemAvailable below 32 GiB sustained for 30 seconds
resource_policy: One inference server at a time; do not terminate display/GUI/PeritoSoft processes; cleanup only this experiment's server PID.
